description: This file defines an Angular service AuthService that manages user authentication state, handling login, registration, and logout functionalities with local storage persistence and routing.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Angular service providing authentication functionalities, including login, registration, logout, and state management.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Simulates user login by creating a user object, storing it in local storage, updating the user state observable, and returning the user as an observable.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Simulates user registration similarly to login, updating local storage and user state.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears user data from local storage, updates user state to null, and navigates the user to the login page.

ctags.name: displayName
ctags.pattern: /^    const user: User = { id: 'local-uid', email, displayName: null };$/

ctags.pattern: /^    const user: User = { id: 'local-uid', email, displayName: null };$/
